purpose: Development-only common-warm L H1 versus L H2 training-horizon effect; separate from architecture selection and fixed-state derivative diagnostics.
world_selection: Known dev parent, then first two fact and first two affine_integer dev worlds sorted by world_id, matching the existing development queue.
reuse: Only the ten declared L_2560 development runs, after complete config/source/input/phi validation. H1 explicitly uses each H2 saved initial adapter; compare final stream states and every route-token count.
score: At each declared step: 0.5*(candidate_accuracy+strict_EM), minus language and keep NLL residual above 0.1 nats. Equal weights for known/fact/rule groups and doses. Report H2 minus H1.
report: Preserve all per-step metrics, paired deltas, recovery costs, endpoint evidence and training costs. No significance claim from one training seed, no change to frozen architecture-selection policy.
gate: Both endpoints need their own complete artifact audit and independent scientific review receipt before recovery. Same L-H2 phi_0512 and optimizer warm state; same subsequent schedule, seeds, parent/data inputs and cumulative 2560 budget. Never compare H1_2560 with H2_3584.
